# Non-vacuity fixture for the bash-4-construct lint in `ley test syntax`.
#
# Every uncommented line below uses a construct that bash 3.2 (macOS /bin/bash,
# this repo's stated shell floor) accepts at PARSE time and then fails on at
# RUNTIME. That asymmetry is why the lint is textual rather than a `bash -n`
# sweep, and why this fixture exists: the lint must produce a hit for EVERY
# line here, or it is checking nothing.
#
# Deliberately NOT named *.sh — the syntax sweep must never try to parse it,
# and nothing must ever source it.
lower="${value,,}"
upper="${value^^}"
initial_cap="${value^}"
declare -A associative_map
local -A scoped_map
typeset -A typeset_map
local -n reference=$1
declare -n global_reference=$1
mapfile -t lines < input
readarray -t rows < input
appended &>> combined.log
if [[ -v maybe_unset ]]; then :; fi
coproc worker { cat; }
